witnesses.name: Exact AP filename passed to a metadata-shaped caller
witnesses.inference: ADR computes align(0x167282+4,4)+0x18c = 0x167410. Caller places this pointer on stack and calls 0x1670d0. That callee issues formatting/property-style calls to 0x1d52ea/0x1d5248/0x1d52be. This does not bind a renderer or admission function.

witnesses.name: Generic container signature probe
witnesses.inference: Read 0x16 bytes through 0xfeb36, compare header+0x10 against six-byte DSKIMG; fallback compares DSDIMG. This identifies a shared container type, not AP drawing.

witnesses.name: Shared cache/mount/parser direct-call edges
witnesses.inference: 0xfea50 branch at 0xfea9e calls 0x1e86ce; branch at 0x1e899c in 0x1e86ce calls 0x1e8046. Prior sealed evidence binds this chain to VPM. The present scope has no exact AP-file-to-mount or mount-to-renderer binding.

witnesses.name: Shared geometry uses two dynamic shifts
witnesses.inference: Header+0x61 exponent gives sector bytes 1<<e1, stored as u16 at volume+0x48. Header+0x62 gives sectors/block 1<<e2, masks and 240-block continuation coverage. Header+0x63/64 block count is stored as u16 at +0x4e. For 9+3 vs 9+4 these operations compute 4K vs 8K; there is no fixed delta==3 compare in this 104-byte fragment. Arithmetic alone is not container acceptance.

witnesses.name: Shared branch requires 512-byte sectors
witnesses.inference: Subtracting 7, 255 and 250 compares stored sector size with 512. Equality continues at 0x1e83c8; mismatch branches to 0x1e82ac. Both 9+3 and 9+4 have sector512, so this is not a block-size-4096 guard.

CPU_not_executed: True AP binding unresolved; shared VPM geometry execution would not answer the AP admission question.
